title: Agent Archivist ingest request framing and per-attempt signature parameters (v1)
description: The wire shape of POST /v1/ingest (plan Section 7.2): a multipart/related request whose first part is the canonical envelope and whose second part is the payload in the encoding the envelope declares. The payload streams and is never base64-embedded in JSON. This schema validates the per-attempt signature-parameter record — the values an Ed25519 HTTP message signature covers — and pins the framing constants in metadata. The parameters are attempt state, never envelope content: a retry mints fresh authorization (new epoch-bound timestamp and signature) while the envelope bytes stay identical.

x-archivist.preauthorization: the server MAY pre-authorize uploader_key_id before the body arrives, but commits nothing until the complete signature and payload verify (plan Section 7.2); stale-epoch or window-expired proofs are rejected while an identical authorized retry stays logically idempotent (ID-006, ID-007)
x-archivist.signingConstruction: ingest-attempt-v1 domain label over zero-delimited, length-prefixed fields in the pinned covered order (schemas/v1/ingest-identifiers.json); golden vectors arrive with the language-neutral conformance corpus

http_method.description: HTTP method covered by the signature (plan Section 7.2).

route.description: Route covered by the signature (plan Section 7.2); breaking wire changes use a new route major (plan Section 7.1), so an unknown route value fails closed the same way an unknown major does.

content_type.description: The complete Content-Type header value of the request, including the multipart boundary parameter, covered by the signature (plan Section 7.2).

request_content_digest.description: SHA-256 over the whole multipart/related request body (plan Section 7.2). On-path substitution of body or envelope fails this digest (IA-02).

envelope_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical envelope bytes of part one (plan Section 7.2).

payload_canonical_digest.description: The canonical uncompressed payload digest covered by the signature — equals the envelope's `blob_digest` (plan Section 7.2 payload digests).

payload_transport_digest.description: The incoming-representation digest covered by the signature — equals the envelope's `incoming_checksum` (plan Section 7.2 payload digests).

uploader_key_id.description: The linked uploader key this attempt authorizes under (plan Section 7.2). The server may pre-authorize the key ID before the body arrives, but commits nothing until the complete signature and payload verify.

authorization_epoch.description: Authorization epoch of the uploader key at this attempt (plan Section 7.2): rotations and revocations bump the epoch, and stale-epoch proofs are rejected (ID-006, ID-007).

authorization_timestamp.description: Fresh UTC timestamp bound into this attempt's proof (plan Section 7.2). Valid for the five-minute authorization window; a retry after the window re-authorizes without changing occurrence or attestation identity, because none of this enters the envelope.

signature_algorithm.description: Algorithm of the per-attempt signature; Ed25519 only in v1.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the covered values in the pinned order and construction (plan Section 7.2).
